info.title: Apple Map Links Universal API
info.description: Generate documented Apple Maps links for map framing, search, place cards, Look Around, directions, guides, reports, and legacy map-link formats.

get.description: Frames a map view in Apple Maps.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: center
parameters.description: Map center as a comma-separated latitude,longitude coordinate pair.

schema.description: Map center as a comma-separated latitude,longitude coordinate pair.

parameters.name: span
parameters.description: Visible area span around the center as latitudeDelta,longitudeDelta.

schema.description: Visible area span around the center as latitudeDelta,longitudeDelta.

parameters.name: map
parameters.description: Map type: explore, driving, transit, satellite, or hybrid.

schema.description: Map type: explore, driving, transit, satellite, or hybrid.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Optional location tracking mode: follow, follow-with-heading, or none.

schema.description: Optional location tracking mode: follow, follow-with-heading, or none.

parameters.name: heading
parameters.description: Map camera heading in degrees.

schema.description: Map camera heading in degrees.

parameters.name: pitch
parameters.description: Map camera pitch angle.

schema.description: Map camera pitch angle.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Apparent distance from the viewer to the map surface.

schema.description: Apparent distance from the viewer to the map surface.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Opens Apple Maps directions between locations.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Optional starting point as an address, coordinate, or place name.

schema.description: Optional starting point as an address, coordinate, or place name.

parameters.name: sourcePlaceId
parameters.description: Optional Place ID for the source; requires source.

schema.description: Optional Place ID for the source; requires source.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Ending destination as an address, coordinate, or place name.

schema.description: Ending destination as an address, coordinate, or place name.

parameters.name: destinationPlaceId
parameters.description: Optional Place ID for the destination; requires destination.

schema.description: Optional Place ID for the destination; requires destination.

parameters.name: waypoint
parameters.description: Optional intermediate stop. Apple Maps allows repeating this query parameter for multistop routing.

schema.description: Optional intermediate stop. Apple Maps allows repeating this query parameter for multistop routing.

parameters.name: waypointPlaceId
parameters.description: Optional Place ID for a waypoint.

schema.description: Optional Place ID for a waypoint.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Transportation mode: driving, walking, transit, or cycling.

schema.description: Transportation mode: driving, walking, transit, or cycling.

parameters.name: avoid
parameters.description: Comma-delimited route avoid preferences, such as tolls, highways, busy-roads, or stairs.

schema.description: Comma-delimited route avoid preferences, such as tolls, highways, busy-roads, or stairs.

parameters.name: transitPreferences
parameters.description: Comma-delimited transit preferences: bus, subway, commuter, or ferry.

schema.description: Comma-delimited transit preferences: bus, subway, commuter, or ferry.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Delay in seconds before starting navigation.

schema.description: Delay in seconds before starting navigation.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
